steps.label: Spot vs. forward
steps.sub: settle now, or lock in a future rate

eyebrow: No-arbitrage link between spot, forward, and rates
code:
Forward = Spot x (1 + r_domestic) / (1 + r_foreign)

Example: EUR/USD spot = 1.10
r_USD = 5%,  r_EUR = 3%,  T = 1 year
Forward = 1.10 x (1.05 / 1.03) = 1.10 x 1.0194
Forward = 1.1214  ->  EUR at forward premium
caption: The higher-rate currency (USD) trades at a forward discount, matching the interest rate gap.

eyebrow: Betting the real world doesn't fully offset the gap

steps.label: Stay unhedged
steps.sub: a forward would erase the profit
